description: This file defines coroutine support structures, classes, and macros for asynchronous programming within the 'ocudu' namespace. It includes coroutine frame management, handle types, suspenders, and macros for suspension points and await operations.

classes.name: base_coro_frame
classes.description: Base class for coroutine frames, managing suspension state, awaiters, and coroutine lifecycle.

classes.name: base_coro_frame<void>
classes.description: Specialization of base_coro_frame for void promise type, handling suspension and awaiter management.

classes.name: base_coro_frame<Promise>
classes.description: Extension of base_coro_frame<void> that includes promise object and coroutine state.

classes.name: coro_frame<FunT>
classes.description: Coroutine frame storing the function object, managing resume, destroy, and on_return operations.

classes.name: coro_handle
classes.description: Handle to a coroutine, with specializations for void and Promise types, allowing resume, destroy, and promise access.

classes.name: noop_coroutine_promise
classes.description: A promise type for a coroutine that does nothing on resume or destroy.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes the coroutine from the last suspension point.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the coroutine frame, deallocating resources.

methods.name: on_return
methods.description: Handles cleanup at coroutine return point.

methods.name: get_promise
methods.description: Returns the promise object associated with the coroutine.

methods.name: from_promise
methods.description: Obtains the coroutine frame pointer from a promise object.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the coroutine, resuming via cancel path.
